material.description: International Organization for Standardization, ISO 55001:2024 official overview, “What are the key elements of an asset management system according to ISO 55001?”: identifies an asset-management policy, objectives, design and implementation of a management system, and continuous improvement based on periodic reviews. This supports a coordinated system-level approach to objectives, decisions and improvement at overview level; it is not a clause-level citation or the full paid standard text.
